text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d a c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t a-m-o-n-g t-h-r-e-e a-b-i-d-i-n-g f-i-r-m-s a-n-d r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d i-t o-n a p-r-i-v-a-t-e s-h-a-r-e-d f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e n-o-n-c-o-l-l-u-s-i-o-n c-l-a-u-s-e.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-n-u-f-a-c-t-u-r-e-d c-o-v-e-r b-i-d s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t-s u-s-i-n-g s-c-r-a-p-p-e-d t-e-n-d-e-r t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s a-n-d l-o-g-g-e-d t-h-e-m i-n t-h-e b-i-d p-o-r-t-a-l u-n-d-e-r f-a-l-s-e e-x-p-e-r-t i-s-s-u-e-s w-h-i-l-e d-e-f-e-a-t-i-n-g t-h-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g d-a-t-a a-m-o-n-g c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h a n-u-d-g-e-s-h-e-e-t h-o-s-t-e-d o-n a c-l-o-u-d d-r-i-v-e a-c-c-e-s-s-s-i-b-l-e v-i-a a c-o-m-m-o-n p-a-s-s-w-o-r-d, c-i-r-c-u-m-v-e-n-t-i-n-g t-h-e e-m-p-l-o-y-e-e a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g g-u-a-r-d.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e f-o-r w-h-i-c-h f-i-r-m w-o-u-l-d w-i-n e-a-c-h l-o-t a-n-d t-i-m-e-d s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s t-o a-p-p-e-a-r i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t, d-e-f-e-a-t-i-n-g t-h-e a-b-i-d a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s a-l-g-o-r-i-t-h-m.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-r-r-a-n-g-e-d h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h a g-h-o-s-t s-u-b-c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t-o-r e-n-t-i-t-y a-n-d a-l-l-o-c-a-t-e-d e-x-p-e-n-s-e s-c-o-d-e-s i-n t-h-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t-i-n-g l-e-d-g-e-r, o-v-e-r-r-i-d-i-n-g t-h-e f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l d-u-e d-i-l-i-g-e-n-c-e s-c-r-e-e-n.
